transactions.description: On 2/28/2020, spouse was granted a Restricted Unit Award of L3Harris Technologies, Inc common stock as part of his compensation pursuant to the provisions of the Harris Corporation 2015 Equity Incentive Plan ( see https://disclosures-clerk.house.gov/public_disc/ptr-pdfs/2020/20016276.pdf ). These RSUs vested on 2/28/2023, were distributed on 3/1/2023 at the end of the day, and were sold as soon as possible on 3/2/2023.
